questions.text: Explain components and determinants of aggregate demand.
questions.expectedAnswer: Aggregate demand: total spending on goods and services in economy.
questions.markingGuide: Identify components and explain what determines each.

questions.text: Analyse shifts in aggregate supply and price impacts.
questions.expectedAnswer: Supply shifts from technology, input costs, productivity changes.
questions.markingGuide: Explain mechanisms by which supply changes affect economy.

questions.text: Analyse macroeconomic equilibrium and unemployment-inflation trade-off.
questions.expectedAnswer: Show equilibrium and analyse trade-offs in policy objectives.
questions.markingGuide: Evaluate competing macroeconomic objectives and constraints.

questions.text: Comprehensive macroeconomic analysis with policy implications.
questions.expectedAnswer: Integrate macro analysis with policy design to achieve objectives.
questions.markingGuide: Sophisticated assessment of policy options and outcomes.
